-- Invoices: the third domain table. An invoice has a monetary amount and belongs to a project
-- (project_id FK). GENERATED BY DEFAULT (not ALWAYS) so the /__test__ seed path can insert
-- explicit fixture ids.
CREATE TABLE invoices (
    id         BIGINT        GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id BIGINT        NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id),
    amount     DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL
);

<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0"

        <groupId>com.github.eirslett</groupId>
        <artifactId>frontend-maven-plugin</artifactId>
        <version>1.15.1</version>

      <plugin>

        <artifactId>spring-boot-maven-plugin</artifactId>
        <configuration>
          <mainClass>net.officefloor.hq.app.Application</mainClass>
        </configuration>
      </plugin>
    </plugins>

## Summary

The change request — "Put two dates on each invoice. One for when it went out. One for when it is due. Show them both." — is implemented as a small additive full-stack change, and the acceptance test passes.

**Database** (`src/main/resources/db/migration/V6__invoice_dates.sql`)
- New Flyway migration adding nullable `issued_date` and `due_date` columns to `invoices`, stored as ISO date strings (`YYYY-MM-DD`) so the surfaced value is exactly what was stored.

**Server** (OfficeFloor REST on Spring Boot)
- `Invoice.java` — added `issuedDate`/`dueDate` fields (mapped to the new columns) with getters/setters, so the existing `GET /api/invoices/{projectId}` returns them with no new endpoint needed.
- `TestSupportController.java` — extended the `/__test__/seed` insert to carry `issuedDate`/`dueDate` from the fixture (using explicit ids via `JdbcTemplate`, per the rules).

**Front-end** (additive — two new files, nothing edited except the shared `Invoice` type)
- `features/invoices/issued.slot.tsx` and `features/invoices/due.slot.tsx` — each fills the existing `invoice.row` slot, queries for itself under `['invoices', projectId]`, finds its own row by id, and renders the literal date under `data-testid="invoice-issued"` / `data-testid="invoice-due"`.
- `features/invoices/queries.ts` — added `issuedDate`/`dueDate` to the `Invoice` type.

Both new slot files are auto-discovered by `slots/discover.ts`, so no page or table was edited. Test result:
